notes.title: Patch Notes - 17th December, 2021
notes.content:
Hi users!

Here is a very small non-patch distributed on the sly.

We changed the font of GiGi's song to be smaller, more readable and less pixelated, whatever Mr. Glitch says!

Don't have fun!

notes.title: Patch Notes - 16th December, 2021 (v2)
notes.content:
Hey all,

Glitch maliciously contaminated the last build and hid the saves. The deceiver!
Fortunately, the Creator is on the lookout and immediately corrected the issue.

You should be able to resume your non-game where you left it.

Have no fun.

notes.title: Patch Notes - December 16, 2021
notes.content:
Hello user!

In its madness to conquer the world the Glitch has deployed a new patch and ventures into new lands! 

Improvements:

Added Japanese language
Added Korean language

Good non game everyone!

notes.title: Patch Notes - 5th March, 2021
notes.content:
Hey all,

Here is a small patch that will further deteriorate the experience!

No Improvements:

The Continue button on the chapter selection will be displayed throughout the progression even if you have just unlocked a new chapter.

No bug fixes:

Fixed synchronization issue between sound and image on some videos.

Have no fun.

notes.title: TING: WD won 5 Judges Choice Awards at the 2020 Aggie Awards!
notes.content:
Hello users,

Bad news...
There Is No Game: Wrong Dimension won 5 Judges Choice Awards at the 2020 Aggie (Adventure Gamers) Awards:

- Best Character (Game)
- Best Gameplay
- Best Concept
- Best Non-traditional Adventure
- Best Adventure of 2020

And 6 Readers' Choice Awards:

- Best Character (Game)
- Best Gameplay
- Best Concept
- Best Non-traditional Adventure
- Best Adventure of 2020
- Best Writing (Comedy)

🥳🎉

notes.title: Patch Notes - 9th February, 2021
notes.content:
Hey all,

Glitch has raged again and created a bug in the last patch!

No Bug fixes:

The mouse pointer had its visual that did not correspond to its real position on screen ratios other than 16/9, in Fullscreen mode.

Have no fun.

notes.title: Patch Notes - 8th February, 2021
notes.content:
Hey all,

Here is a new patch, the first of 2021 and completely useless.

No Improvements:

Pointer now scales proportionally to other elements in the scene for more consistency and better accessibility.
The save has been optimized and the loading timings changed to avoid some potential bugs.

No Bug fixes:

Mouse pointer: Fixed a bad visual state occurring during a frame when clicking on an interactive element of the GUI.
Chapter 4: Fixed a softlock in the room with the bridge if it is raised and lowered very quickly when the hero is thrown into the air.
Chapter 4: Fixed a wrong scale of texts on items that can be purchased multiple times.
Chapter 6: Fixed a black screen bug that could occur on the last video.
Chapter 6: Fixed the transfer window which once the loading is complete appeared inverted.

Have no fun.

notes.title: Patch Notes - 1st December, 2020
notes.content:
Hey all,

Here is a small patch of no interest

No Improvements:

Updated Russian translation.
Chapter 6: The machine's comment on the high temperature (when you reach 40 ° while the creator is knocked out) will only be played once and not each time you return to the temperature screen.
Chapter 6: The fuse of the bomb ignites on overlap and no longer on the drop.

No Bug fixes:

Chapter 6: Trying to brew coffee while the Creator was knocked out could prevent future Glitch calls.
Main menu credits did not loop properly after changing languages.

Have no fun.

notes.title: Patch Notes - 14th November
notes.content:
Здравствуйте, пользователь!

Today, we're excited to announce that the non-game now supports russian subtitles!

Improvements:

Added Russian language (Special thanks to Px-Ch for his big help!).

Fixes:

Save System: In a rather unlikely case, the overall progress could be reset.
Chapter 3: a rare softlock was possible on the fall of the chest in the first room.
Chapter 6: It was possible to complete the riddle of the coffee machine by selecting the sweetener in the combination.
Small fixes (brightness of some videos, pronunciations of some lines...)


Good non game everyone!

notes.title: Patch Notes - 20th October
notes.content:
Buongiorno !

Today, we're excited to announce that the non-game now supports italian subtitles!

Improvements:

Added Italian language.

Fixes:

Chapter 1: When we use the large key on the locked folder, reduce the key and use it quickly on the padlock, we can have a soft lock.
Chapter 6: Some events related to videos could not be triggered in the right order in case of big system lag.
Chapter 5: If we reload the checkpoint that follows the unscrewing of the double arrow, it is possible to see the end screen of the Atomic Cucumber minigame while the My Cat plate is not attached to the GameDesign slot.
Chapter 2: The text of the Miss Voodoo ad on the side of the screen overflows in the German language.
Hint system. The text "Next tips in" was not correctly localized if the language was changed via the options menu.


Good non game everyone!

notes.title: Patch Notes - 24th September
notes.content:
Hey all,

A small patch in the wind.

No Bug fixes:

The poor goat has gotten tiny on the chapter 1 book since the last patch. Here it's now back to its normal size!

Have no fun.

notes.title: Patch Notes - 23rd September
notes.content:
Hey all,

Here is a new patch that does absolutely nothing!

No Bug fixes:

Chapter 6 only:

 A rare softlock on a black screen at the end of chapter instead of displaying the last video and going to the next chapter.
 A rare softlock on the phone call screen if the stunned narrator was called at a specific time.
 A rare bug that made the phone keyboard disappear, forcing the player to close and reopen the panel.
 A small bug where the narrator was still blowing bubbles when the door was opened in the water.

No Changes:

 Re-recording of Russian voices.


Have no fun.

notes.title: Patch Notes - 12th September
notes.content:
Hey all,

Two corrections today, one of which is no doubt eagerly awaited.


Fixed a bug where Gigi's song text would not display correctly in Chapter 5.
Improved voice reproduction to remove some audio artifacts.


Have no fun.

notes.title: Patch Notes 3rd - 5th September
notes.content:
Hey all,

Today is a patch day.


Fixed an persistent issue on Chapter 4 where player can be stuck if he opens the store as the hero tries out a new sword (not the first one) and says "Broken again ...".


Have no fun.

notes.title: Patch Notes 2nd - 5th September
notes.content:
Hey all,

A special patch to fix a newly added bug. Sorry for our mistake.


Fixed an issue where, in Chapter 5, Old Tv postFx would stay forever once triggered.
Fixed an issue on Chapter 6 where you could get stuck on the phone call screen after raising the temperature just after using the coffee machine.


Have no fun.

notes.title: Patch Notes - 5th September
notes.content:
Hey all,

Another small patch.


Add fixes from the community for the Chinese localization (special thanks to @SuperContact for his help).
Fixed display of texts in Chinese credits.
Fixed a rare issue which could allow unlocking the next chapter before having finished the current one.
Minor fixes of some graphic assets for better readability.


Have no fun.

notes.title: Patch Notes - 27th August
notes.content:
Hey all,

Go a little further with some new fixes.

Fixes:

Fixed a bug in Chapter 3 where the hero could return to the clearing instead of falling into the water if the top lily pad was enlarged.
Fixed a bug in chapter 4 where the hand in the Paper Please ad might not be interactive at very low framerate.
Fixed a bug in Chapter 4 where the banner ad remained visible and could not be closed if ever the sun was purchased while the banner was spawning.


Improvements

Integration of the new Chinese language translation.


Good non game everyone!

notes.title: Patch Notes - 21st August
notes.content:
Hey all,

A very small patch on a few points that bothered us a bit:

- Re-recording some voices.
- Adjustment of the colorimetry of some assets in chapter 2.
- Fixed an issue where some small decor elements did not appear in chapter 2.

Have fun.

notes.title: Patch Notes - 16th August
notes.content:
Hey all,

Go a little further with some new fixes.

Fixes:

Fixed an issue where the hammer from Chapter 3 would slide off-screen (forever) if used on the feather around the time the guard unhook it.
Fixed an issue on the boss in Chapter 3, which in rare cases did not launch its wave of spikes.
Fixed an issue where we made the hero jump once the door is open without making an error in the snake room in Chapter 3.
Fixed an issue where the bomb was no longer interactive if we closed the Bomb Sweeper window while the bomb was moving in Chapter 6
Fixed an issue in Chapter 6 where it was possible to wake up the creator without the light boost and without the temperature alert which could lead to a softlock.
Fixed an issue where under certain circumstances you could get stuck on the calling screen in Chapter 6.



Improvements

- Chapter 4: Adding clickable objects in order to have money faster in specific rooms and reducing the switches cost in the dungeon.
- Chapter 6: Glitch can be grabbed more easily.


Good game everyone!

notes.title: Patch Notes - 14th August
notes.content:
Hey all,

Go a little further with some new fixes.

Fixes:

Fixed an issue which made the global save file unusable as well as its back-up if ever a crash (or power failure, or other ...) occurred during its update.
Fixed an issue that allowed to buy switches in Chapter 4 while the hero was moving in the Sun phase.
Updated the font with a missing character for the German language.


Known issue:

In chapter 3, for several players, the hammer can cross the screen and disappear, leading to a softlock.


Good game everyone!

notes.title: Patch Notes - 12th August
notes.content:
Hey all,

Another small patch thanks to your bug feedback.

Fixes :

Fixed an issue where the player could get stuck in chapter 6 if he enters the wrong code in Home and tries to exit the menu very quickly.
Fixed a bug where a comment from Game on the doormat could interrupt the sequence of knocking on the door in Chapter 1, which can cause a softlock.
Fixed a bug where the rain postFX effect and some animations could fail to trigger at the time of the first thunderclap on Chapter 6.
Adjusted the Bomb gameplay in Chapter 3, so some enlightened players can't partially bypass it.
Minor localization fixes especially in Chinese.


Good game everyone!

notes.title: Patch Notes - 10th August
notes.content:
Hey all,

Thank you as always for your feedback
We continue to fix bugs.

Fixes :

Attempted to fix the bug where the videos could not be displayed in chapter 5 preventing the player from continuing.
Fixed the bug where the wooden panel could permanently stick to the tetris in chapter 5 if you immediately exit the minigame while it was still glued.
Minor localization fixes.


Known issues

In rare people, the safe in the chapter 1 does not come off once the handle is turned, although the two cogs are present in the mechanism.


Good game everyone!

notes.title: Patch Notes - 8th August
notes.content:
Hey all,

Thanks again for all your feedback.
We continue to fix bugs.

Fixes :

 Fixed the following issue in the chapter selection screen : if you click on a chapter while you have the Continue button and answer "No" to the confirmation prompt, then click on Continue, this will load the chapter you clicked. You will then lose your current chapter progress if this chapter is not the chapter corresponding to the save.
Fixed an issue in chapter 3 where after having got the sword, if you use the Home stone during the screen change, it is possible to move the lily pad before the hero falls into the water which can cause a softlock.
Fixed an issue in chapter 6 where it was possible to bring out the speaker icon from the screen if you hit the screen several times with the bubble while the pointer is moving towards the speaker.
Fixed an issue where the Hero would get stuck if the player opened the shop before the Hero started returning to the Pedestal, the very first time, in Chapter 4.
Fixed an issue where the snake disappearance FX was not displayed.


Known issues

In rare people, videos may not be displayed leading to a softlock especially in Chapter 5.
In rare people, the safe in the chapter 1 does not come off once the handle is turned, although the two cogs are present in the mechanism.


Good game everyone!

notes.title: Patch Notes - 7th August
notes.content:
Hey all,

Thanks for all your feedback.
This has allowed us to make a number of fixes, listed below.

Fixes :

Fixed an issue where the player could get stuck if the bomb explodes during a specific point in the Rapappa animation in chapter 4.
Fixed an issue where the player could get stuck in chapter 4 if he uses the hammer on the energy gauge less than 3 sec after picking it from the chest.
Fixed an issue where the player could get stuck at the beginning of the Rogue Quizz in chapter 6 because the Narrator's lamentation did not stop.
Fixed an issue where the symbols no longer collide with the Transfert Box during the second phase of the TicTacToe in chapter 6.
Fixed an issue where non-interactive door-related sequences in chapter 1 could be interrupted by narrator dialogue, leading to a softlock.
Fixed an issue where you could unlock a hint while the hint interface was closing and after that the hint was no longer displayed.


Improvements :

Slight increase in the time interval to make the paper guy fall in chapter 4.


Known Issues:

WARNING : In the chapter selection screen. If you click on a chapter while you have the Continue button and answer "No" to the confirmation prompt, then click on Continue, this will load the chapter you clicked. You will then lose your current chapter progress if this chapter is not the chapter corresponding to the save.
In chapter 3, after having got the sword, if you use the Home stone during the screen change, it is possible to move the lily pad before the hero falls into the water which can cause a softlock.


Good game everyone!
